title: Register a patient
summary: Register a patient with their contact details. The phone is used for WhatsApp reminders.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: New patient
steps.details: Opens the new patient form. Your license may limit new patients per month.

steps.title: First and last name
steps.details: As it will appear on appointments, quotes and invoices.

steps.title: Phone
steps.details: With country code. Without a phone they don't get reminders or WhatsApp messages.

steps.title: Email
steps.details: Optional: enables sending quotes and invoices by email.

steps.title: ID
steps.details: Recommended for invoicing and to avoid duplicate patients.

steps.title: Date of birth
steps.details: Shows the age on the record and enables the birthday greeting.

steps.title: Default doctor
steps.details: It's suggested when booking an appointment for them.

steps.title: Are they a dependent?
steps.details: Check it if they're a minor or in a guardian's care: notices go to the responsible contact.

steps.title: Save the patient
steps.details: Creates the patient. From their record you can now book, quote and charge.
